trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum pops on its own, with no online play or DLC needed.

steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies first; this one pops on its own once they are all done, with no online play or DLC needed.
Work the roadmap in order - story, then the 100% checklist, then Strangers & Freaks and cleanup - and check the counter in the trophy list as you go.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1; it pops when the mission ends.

steps.text: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing in Chapter 1; the trophy pops when it ends.
It is automatic and cannot be missed; chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter, so do not worry if it lands a little late.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 1; the trophy pops as the chapter closes.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 1; the trophy pops as the chapter closes.
Keep a manual save at the start of each chapter - there is no mission replay, so chapter saves are your only backup.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2; the trophy pops as the chapter closes.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 2; the trophy pops as the chapter closes.
Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3; the trophy pops as the chapter closes.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 3; the trophy pops as the chapter closes.
Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4; the trophy pops as the chapter closes.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 4; the trophy pops as the chapter closes.
Chapter trophies can pop at the start of the next chapter rather than on the last cutscene.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.disagree_note: PowerPyx places the final mission in Chapter 4, as Starting From Zero [1]; Beebom and CULTR, quoted by eGamers, word it as Chapter 5 [4]. Both versions are shown; neither is picked here.
trophies.guide: Finish the final story mission; sources disagree on whether it sits in Chapter 4 or Chapter 5.

steps.text: Finish the final story mission; the trophy pops when it ends.

Sources disagree on the chapter: PowerPyx places the final mission in Chapter 4, as Starting From Zero, while Beebom and CULTR, quoted by eGamers, word it as Chapter 5 - both versions are shown, neither is picked here.
Keep an untouched manual save from just before the final mission, since there is no mission replay.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run; it pops during the mission.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run; the trophy pops during it.
It is automatic and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist; it pops during the mission.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 3 mission The Cartel Heist; the trophy pops during it.
It is automatic and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play; it pops during the mission.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 mission Child's Play; the trophy pops during it.
It is automatic and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission Headliners; it pops during the mission.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 mission Headliners; the trophy pops during it.
It is automatic and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown; it pops during the mission.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 4 mission VCIA Takedown; the trophy pops during it.
It is automatic and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory; it pops during the mission.

steps.text: Play the Chapter 5 mission Operation Savage Glory; the trophy pops during it.
It is automatic and cannot be missed.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Clear the 100% checklist after the story: lenient targets, about 100 hours, nothing on it missable.

steps.text: Open the checklist under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion once it appears after the story; progress made earlier already counts.
Finish the story first (60-80 hours), then work the checklist in free roam for about 100 hours.
Aim for the lenient targets, not everything: 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 70 of 80 challenges, 300 stunts, 100 optional tasks.
Some lines need everything: all 39 gang operations, all 22 bank jobs, all 8 bank vaults, all 42 shooting-range golds and all 15 target decks.
Nothing on the checklist is missable, and it stays open after the story, so clean it up last.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Pull off any 250 of the 397 stunts; keep going to 300 for the 100% checklist.

steps.text: Complete any 250 stunts out of 397; the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past the trophy.
Mix the four kinds - 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps - and pick the quickest; under-the-bridge runs are fastest.
Track progress by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts, or on the map under Exploration > Stunt Spots.
One clean run of each stunt counts as completed; the map icons stay marked once done.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once; most come up on their own during the story.

steps.text: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, video games, car races and stunts.
Check the tracker under Touchpad > Progress > Activities; scrolling over each type shows how many you have done.
Most types come up on their own during the story and the 100% checklist, so this usually pops without a separate grind.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges.

steps.text: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges.
Gold medals are needed in full for the 100% checklist too, so they count twice.
Work the ranges as you open them; the golds are not very hard, and range practice also raises Focus.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; one win per location is enough.

steps.text: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; one win per location is enough for the trophy.
All 42 drone races (and the 42 drone time trials) are needed for 100%, so keep racing past the trophy.
Find the 14 race locations across Leonida; each location hosts its own drone races.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations.

steps.text: Win 20 different races out of the 40 unique race locations; winning the same race twice does not count.
Races cover car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races.
The 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 races won, so keep racing past the trophy.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Follow Cal's fishing questline after Feng Shui and beat him in his fishing challenge.

steps.text: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, when you meet Cal, wait for his text; it marks a fishing spot with a purple map icon.
Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in the fishing challenge it sets.
Fishing also counts toward the activity types for Master of None and raises Focus.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 arcade games.

steps.text: Play one of the 4 arcade games - Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind or Bang For Your Buck - and finish all its levels once.
The first three are on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines around the world.
You only need to reach the end of one game, not beat every challenge in it.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's 5-quest Cellerica line in Chapter 3, playing as Lucia.

steps.text: Wait for Andy's call during Chapter 3 while playing as Lucia; she texts her home address and marks the questline in Belville.
Work her 5 quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass.
The questline is Lucia-only, and all quests stay open after the story.
Finish the last one, Puff Puff Pass, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Dive Kenton's 7 shipwrecks and bring the treasures back to his shop in Key Lento.

steps.text: After the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams, wait for Kenton's call; he is marked by the green KR icon in Key Lento.
Dive his treasure sets: he marks purple chest icons, you dig the treasure up with the metal detector and bring it back.
Clear 7 shipwrecks across his sets; after each set he calls you back to his shop and marks more.
Track it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures; he is not missable - he returns in Chapters 2-3.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's 5 jobs from the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.

steps.text: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, the questline marks at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County.
Work his 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes.
All quests stay open after the story.
Finish Hometown Heroes and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.disagree_note: PowerPyx names 4 counting strands (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete) and adds that more are yet to be discovered [1]; OutputLog agrees only some questlines count and names the same split [2]. Both versions are shown; check the trophy counter after each strand.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands - Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete count; do Yago's race the moment it appears.

steps.text: Finish 8 qualifying stranger strands; only some questlines count - Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete do, while Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not.
Sources disagree on the full list: PowerPyx names 4 strands and adds that more are yet to be discovered, so check the trophy counter after each strand you finish.
WATCH: Yago's Race Against Yago in Chapter 3 is time-sensitive (hourglass icon) - save first and race it the moment it appears.
Strangers stay open after the story in free roam, so the rest can be cleaned up last.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver all 16 sports cars on Randy's wish list to his garage in west Vice City.

steps.text: After the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, steal the Zorrusso for Randy; that unlocks the Key Cloner and his 16-car wish list.
Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are on the list, then drive each one back to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City).
Track the list under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List; cars he marks respawn, and he marks new ones as you deliver.
Delivering in good condition pays more; finish the list and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Smash Tyrone's Synthetic Labs in Vice City, then shut them down for good.

steps.text: After the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty, follow the purple markers to the Synthetic Labs in Vice City (Jason only).
Destroy enough labs in Take Out Kitty Litter, then Tyrone offers Spin On This.
Shut the labs down in Spin On This and the trophy pops; it all stays open after the story.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.disagree_note: Guides say 18 meditations for the trophy while the 100% list stops at 15 [3][4]. Whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is required for the trophy is still unconfirmed everywhere [1][2][3].
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots, both characters at each - and do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation before it is gone for good.

steps.text: Finish Down to Earth, then find Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house the next morning and take the meditation prompt.
Follow her to the balcony and choose Accept; this one-time offer adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a spot.
Keep a Chapter 1 manual save until this trophy has popped - the balcony meditation is gone after Chapter 1.
At each marked spot, meditate with both leads: each spot then counts twice.
You cannot finish the last meditation until both characters play together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Track it under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
Counts differ: guides say 18 meditations for the trophy while the 100% list stops at 15 - both versions are shown.
A second launch-day list agrees the balcony meditation is the only possible missable and that it is unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it - do it anyway to be safe.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt Bret's animals as Jason; which animal unlocks it is still unconfirmed.

steps.text: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, wait for Bret Vogel's text while playing as Jason; it marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County.
Work Bret's hunting quests and bring the animals he requests back to him as Jason, using the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle he gives you.
UNCONFIRMED: no guide has yet pinned down which animal unlocks this - finish his 15 target decks and the trophy should come with them.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets; the checklist wants 15.

steps.text: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets; the 100% checklist wants 15 of 18, so keep collecting.
Each set needs its cards found across Leonida; sets you finish count toward both the trophy and the 100% checklist.
You do not need all 18 sets - 3 is enough for the trophy.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots - landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags.

steps.text: Scan 100 spots with the WAiNK app: hold Up then R1 on landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags.
Any mix counts - 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the rest tags - so scan whatever you pass.
The 100% checklist also wants 100 WAiNK scans, so this pops on the same run.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges; the checklist wants 70.

steps.text: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges; the 100% checklist wants 70, so keep going.
Track them under Progress > Challenges, where the completed checkmark shows in the bottom right as you scroll.
Many complete on their own while you work other trophies - save the hardest ones for last and skip 10.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Reach 4 stars with your partner beside you, then escape the red heat zone.

steps.text: Wait until after Coffee Break in Chapter 2, when both leads can free-roam together; call your partner with Right + Triangle.
Build a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then escape the red heat zone - leaving the flashing search area alone is not enough.
Easiest escape: a fast sports bike through traffic, or the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and helicopters lose you.
It also pops on its own during the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, since bank vaults always bring 4 stars.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while the wanted level never drops.

steps.text: After Coffee Break, call your partner and rob 3 shops in a row while the wanted level never drops.
Keep the red/blue flashing wanted level the whole time - if the stars fade to only the red heat zone, the chain breaks.
A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City, open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3; loot a few items and crack each back-room safe.
The pop is delayed about 30 seconds after leaving the third shop; if it does not land, hit a fourth shop and keep going.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Scan 100 vehicles with the WAiNK app; scanning is enough, no need to drive them.

steps.text: Scan 100 vehicles with the WAiNK app (hold Up, then R1); you only need to scan them, not drive them.
Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic; new unique models add to the database.
Check totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles; the 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base models, so this pops early.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 gang enemies in one Combat Focus: fill Focus first, then line them up.

steps.text: Press L3 + R3 while aiming to trigger Combat Focus, which slows time and marks weak spots; it drains the purple focus bar.
Fill Focus first - eat, drink, or use Adrenaline (L1, then Triangle) to stretch the slow-motion window.
Line up 5 gang enemies, for example at a gang operation, and drop them all in one use with an assault rifle like the Duke 556.
It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians, so pick gang targets; Focus reaches level 4 as you play.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a passenger jet docked at a VCIA boarding bridge and fly 1 km out.

steps.text: At VCIA, steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal - the easiest are at gates E3/E4; planes parked on the open airfield do not count.
Go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse the plane to the airstrip and take off.
Fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport; the pop is delayed until you are that far out.
Save first - police arrive fast - and drive in through a fence rather than walking the terminal.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino tank at Mile Zero Air Station and fight from inside it.

steps.text: Go to Mile Zero Air Station on the island at the south-west edge of the map, in Mariana County; tanks stand in the south of the base.
Drive through the gate or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a Rhino tank and shoot enemies until it pops.
Save first; the base is guarded, so expect a fight on the way in.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Slip into a jewelry store through the back door with the Snap Gun and loot the safe unseen.

steps.text: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 first; it gives you the Snap Gun and opens jewelry store robberies.
Enter a jewelry store through the locked back door with the Snap Gun - kicking the door sets the alarm off.
Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and disable the alarm.
Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good target; the trophy pops shortly after you leave unseen.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.disagree_note: PowerPyx lists 8 large bank vaults [1]; KeenGamer's 100% table counts 22 bank jobs [3]. Different categories, both shown.
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape the 4-star heat.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is; it opens bank vault robberies and you do the first vault inside it.
Tail a security van to a bank, slip in while the guard has the vault open, and bring your partner - you cannot carry all the cash alone.
Rob any 5 vaults and escape the 4-star heat on a fast bike; the 100% checklist wants all 8.
Counts differ: PowerPyx lists 8 large bank vaults while KeenGamer's 100% table counts 22 bank jobs - different categories, both shown.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck - a bank vault job counts - and escape the heat.

steps.text: Rob a bank vault as in Maximum Withdrawal - a vault job counts as an armored truck robbery.
Or catch an armored truck driving near a bank in Vice City: block it, stick a bomb on the back door and blow it open.
Escape the red heat radius afterwards (or use a Pay 'n' Spray); the trophy pops only once you are clear.
Sticky bombs sit in the back of Yasmani's shop once you have done his jobs.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map of Leonida; a plane is the fastest way to cover it.

steps.text: Unfog the whole map of Leonida; fly a plane over every black-fogged area until it all shows.
A plane is the fastest way to cover the map; work region by region.
Check the map as you go; fogged patches still show dark, so sweep them until none are left.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs; all 39 count toward 100%.

steps.text: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs; operations show as yellow icons when you go near them.
Track each gang under Progress > Gangs; scrolling over a gang shows how many of its operations you have robbed.
The 100% checklist wants all 39 operations, so this pops on the way.
Many operations get marked on their own as the story progresses.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar and drink it by the bar.

steps.text: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach and buy an Apple Martini.
Drink it while standing next to the bar, looking out at the view, and the trophy pops.
Older guides listed this as unconfirmed, but the launch-day guide gives the bar, the drink and the spot.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Banshee from the south Vice City showroom and drive it through the window.

steps.text: First unlock the Key Cloner in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs - you cannot steal the car without it.
Go to the vehicle showroom in south Vice City and take the blue Banshee; only this car counts.
Hack in with the Key Cloner, drive forward and smash straight through the showroom window.
The pop is slightly delayed and lands once you are further down the street; older guides listed this as unconfirmed, but the launch-day guide gives the full method.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn: take all 3 key valuables, then escape the police.

steps.text: Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, a gang operation you reach during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.
Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first; you need them to blow the office safe.
Take all 3 key valuables: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the north-east table, and the safe contents.
Escape the police and the trophy pops; if you miss an item, the operation respawns later, so it is not missable.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time.

steps.text: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time; check each under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > Strength.
Buy a gym membership and always train together - call your partner with Right + Triangle - so both gain while one works out.
You can only switch between both characters after Coffee Break in Chapter 2; gyms are listed under Map > Activities.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile; it fills passively.

steps.text: Perform 500 actions that change your Criminal Profile; check the count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
Turn on profile notifications under Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile, so a demon face shows whenever an action counts.
It fills passively through robberies and fights across the whole run; if it is still short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops - but avoid the permanent Irredeemable profile.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: no launch-day guide gives a method; believed to be tied to the Payday Loans store.

steps.text: UNCONFIRMED: no launch-day guide gives a method; PowerPyx marks it currently unknown, believed to be tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue.
Keep playing normally and check the trophy list - it may pop on its own; do not grind a guessed method.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Find the blinking car north-west of Starlet Motel after 2AM and follow the UFO.

steps.text: Go to the road north-west of Starlet Motel in Kelly County at night, after 2AM, and come solo.
Look for a blinking car at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back until it spawns.
Follow the path into the woods from the car, approach the UFO, then talk to the woman it drops and walk her back to her car.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: no launch-day guide gives a method; believed to be kicking enemies from a motorcycle.

steps.text: UNCONFIRMED: no launch-day guide gives a method; PowerPyx marks it currently unknown, believed to be from kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle.
Keep playing normally and check the trophy list - it may pop on its own; do not grind a guessed method.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through fences; the total is cumulative.

steps.text: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check first; it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer for laundering marked bills.
Rob banks and Payday Loans, then bring the marked bills to a fence - Yasmani in Vice City pays the most.
The $250,000 total is cumulative across robberies, not one delivery; bank vaults alone can pay up to $205,000 each.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops; guns, mods and tattoos are fastest.

steps.text: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops; the total is cumulative.
Guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest way there, since they cost the most.
Shops of every kind count: 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 14 mod shops and more.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages in the Vice City Real Estate app, about $160,000 total.

steps.text: Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the Vice City Real Estate phone app; together they cost about $160,000.
Garages open for purchase after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver; the 4 story garages do not count.
Robberies are the quickest way to fund them, especially the higher-value jobs in Chapters 3-4.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 stolen vehicles through the Scooter Bros app; buy garages first for the space.

steps.text: Unlock the Scooter Bros app in the Chapter 2 mission Moses, then buy garages first - each one adds parking spots to register vehicles in.
Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray, then Register; from Chapter 3 you can also register standard-tracker cars at a Pay 'n' Spray.
Register 10 vehicles in total; cheap low-end cars and bikes keep the cost down.
